question: In a certain code language, 'FLASK' is written as 'IPFYR'. How will 'TOURS' be written in that language?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20c47703ecd07a9fd48dce0af141ac506f3bea040d8db9c20d1d727f226d3e68.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'FLASK' is written as 'IPFYR'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1e891c57f2c459889e68fe445d730d1b8664e0bf9cf9514ddb11d9da9c890a8.png]

'TOURS' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8113b40cee02735dc1855a81e70fc8ab52c99043a62c24d523e58d08c77f15fc.png]
